title: SUFA CRM deploy / pilot harness
purpose: Single source of truth for go/no-go: automated gates, eval suite paths, feature-flag dependencies, and manual Supabase/Cloudflare work. Agents and humans use the same file.

check.description: sync coach-note-core + typecheck + lint + format:check + unit/component tests

campaignUnit.command: pnpm exec vitest run src/lib/campaignManagement.test.ts src/lib/campaignCapabilities.test.ts src/lib/questionnaireImport.test.ts
campaignUnit.description: Matrix completeness, NPS thresholds, U24 capability gating, questionnaire CSV import

coachNotesDeterministic.description: Coach note schema, grounding, decision suppression, multi-turn, core sync

coachNotesLive.description: Live Edge Function eval against synthetic.v1.jsonl (requires staging coach JWT)

supabase.notes: Apply via Supabase SQL Editor in filename order. Closed roster + append-only matrix history required before enabling.

cloudflare.notes: Set only after migrations are applied on the linked Supabase project. Rebuild/redeploy Pages after env change.

manualChecks: Admin can open U24 campaign and see live matrix status panel
Coach can select a roster player and load that player's submitted self-evaluations
Coach can submit a matrix assessment, then start a second assessment (soft 2/2 UI when shipped)
Player can submit multiple self-evaluations (journal) and see history
Player can see submitted coach assessments about themselves only
VITE_ENABLE_CAMPAIGN_EVALUATION_MATRIX.goNoGo: NO-GO if migrations missing, flag on without history indexes, or coaches can edit submitted rows.

supabase.notes: End-of-campaign retrospective questionnaire (U20-style Likert/NPS). Mutually exclusive with peer NPS on U24 when enabled via campaignCapabilities.

cloudflare.notes: Set VITE_ENABLE_CAMPAIGN_NPS=false for U24 pilot. Rebuild/redeploy Pages after env change.

manualChecks: Pilot campaigns exist: U24 Mixed (c-u24), Opens (c-u24-opens), Womens (c-u24-womens), plus c-survey-test for prod smoke without matrix
Admin uploads one questionnaire CSV (audience column) and commits player + coach templates on #survey
Admin publishes questionnaire, opens window, sees completion roster and aggregate preview
Assigned players and coaches see sectioned Likert form; coaches skip player_only items
Admin exports responses CSV; chase-message copy available on #survey
Google Forms is not required for pilot end-of-tournament survey
VITE_ENABLE_CAMPAIGN_QUESTIONNAIRE.goNoGo: NO-GO if flag on without campaign_questionnaires migration, or peer NPS UI still shown on U24 pilot campaigns.

supabase.notes: Bidirectional NPS (players↔coaches). Prefer enabling with evaluation matrix for U24 pilot.

manualChecks: Admin opens exactly one end-of-campaign NPS survey for the pilot (post/end window; leave mid closed)
Assigned players and coaches see NPS tasks and can submit once per target
Admin aggregate report shows both directions with withhold thresholds
Coaches never see raw individual NPS responses
Google Forms is not required for this campaign's NPS
VITE_ENABLE_CAMPAIGN_NPS.goNoGo: NO-GO if flag on without bidirectional_nps migration, or raw responses visible to coaches.

supabase.notes: Legacy SEA Games Growth Matrix. Keep OFF for U24 pilot.

cloudflare.notes: Not part of U24 pilot profile.

manualChecks: Only enable for SEA Games / Growth Matrix demos, not U24 Worlds pilot
VITE_ENABLE_PLAYER_GROWTH_MATRIX.goNoGo: For pilot-u24 profile this flag must stay false in Cloudflare Pages.

supabase.notes: Lives on legacy /coach/evaluations route, not U24 live matrix. Partial migration apply breaks telemetry.

cloudflare.notes: Enable only after Edge Function deploy + deterministic + live evals pass.

manualChecks: structure-coach-notes deployed and returns grounded drafts for a staging coach JWT
Failed remote generation does not silently swap in deterministic output without coach consent
Copilot never writes ratings/recommendations; coach saves explicitly
VITE_ENABLE_COACH_LLM.goNoGo: NO-GO if live eval gates fail, Edge Function missing, or flag on without coach-note migrations.

baseline.description: Minimum gate before any merge or Pages deploy that does not enable optional flags.
manualChecks: Cloudflare Pages build has VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, VITE_APP_URL when using Supabase backend
Optional VITE_ENABLE_* flags remain false unless their profile below is green
baseline.verdictRule: GO only if all automatedSuites pass and listed manualChecks are confirmed.

pilot-u24.description: Three U24 team campaigns (Mixed, Opens, Womens); open roster (~12-25 players, 1-3 coaches); soft coach 2/2; player journal; in-app end-of-campaign questionnaire (replaces Google Forms). Peer NPS and Coach LLM stay off.
manualChecks: Pilot campaigns exist (Mixed, Opens, Womens); admin can import roster CSV (~22/team) and assign coaches (1-3) via UI
c-survey-test campaign exists for prod smoke with questionnaire only (no matrix)
Magic-link emails for pilot players/coaches are deliverable (not .test) if using real Auth
Campaign migrations applied on the target Supabase project (matrix + closed roster + history + questionnaires)
Cloudflare Pages env matches requiresFlagsOn/Off for this profile
U24 UI does not push coaches onto legacy Growth Matrix or /coach/evaluations for the pilot path
Admin can publish/open/close end-of-campaign questionnaire on #survey (peer NPS stays off)
Soft UI shows coach assessment progress toward 2 submits per player (nudge at 0; confirm at/over 2; no hard DB cap)
acceptance: Admin assigns coaches from campaign UI without SQL
Admin can preview and commit a campaign roster CSV (create/assign by email; one campaign per file)
Admin can import questionnaire CSV and publish player + coach templates
Coach can filter/select by player and load that player's records
Coach can submit two matrix assessments per player within the campaign (soft limit)
Player can view past self-evaluations and submit unlimited journal entries
Player can view coaches' submitted assessments about them
Admin runs in-app questionnaire at campaign end; completion roster + export; Forms not required
pilot-u24.verdictRule: GO only if automatedSuites pass, every requiresFlagsOn dependency (migrations + Cloudflare env) is confirmed, requiresFlagsOff remain false, and all acceptance bullets are demonstrated on the pilot roster.

coach-llm.description: Enable remote Evaluation copilot on legacy coach evaluation page.
manualChecks: All coach-note migrations applied in order
structure-coach-notes Edge Function deployed with secrets
Human blind-review gate in docs/coach-llm.md considered for production
acceptance: Live eval suite green against deployed function
Coach can structure notes without auto ratings/recommendations
coach-llm.verdictRule: GO only if automated + live suites pass and Edge Function secrets are set. Otherwise keep VITE_ENABLE_COACH_LLM=false.

agentRules: Treat harness/manifest.json as authoritative for flag→migration→eval mapping; update it in the same PR when flags, migrations, or eval commands change.
Do not enable a VITE_ENABLE_* flag in Cloudflare until that flag's supabase.migrationsInOrder are applied on the linked project.
Unprovisioned infra → leave flag false (production-safe default).
Agents have no direct DB access; list manual Supabase/Cloudflare steps explicitly in the final response.
Do not weaken tests or skip harness gates to force a GO.
